breakdown.description: Method section specifies dt=0.0005 with 240 steps, which does not match the requested final time T=0.1.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that 240 steps at dt=0.0005 would result in a final time of T=0.12, which contradicts the specified T=0.1. The agent correctly recalculated the number of steps as T/dt = 0.1/0.0005 = 200, aligning with the ground truth.
